verilog_input.description: input VERILOG file, provide circuit netlist information if it is not included in DEF file

num_bins_x.description: number of bins in horizontal direction; computed by internal heuristic if not specified

num_bins_y.description: number of bins in vertical direction; computed by internal heuristic if not specified

global_place_stages.description: global placement configurations of each stage, a dictionary of {"num_bins_x", "num_bins_y", "iteration", "learning_rate", "learning_rate_decay", "wirelength", "optimizer", "Llambda_density_weight_iteration", "Lsub_iteration"}. optimizer can be one of the following: nesterov, adam, sgd, rmsprop, adagrad, adadelta, adamax, adamw, nadam, yogi, radam, adabelief, adabound, adafactor, diffgrad, novograd, cg_fr, cg_prp, cg_hs, cg_cd, cg_ls, cg_dy, cg_hz, cg_hs-dy. The default optimizer is nesterov. Convergence is not guaranteed when using other optimizers.

scale_factor.description: scale factor to avoid numerical overflow; 0.0 means not set

shift_factor.description: shift factor to avoid numerical issues when the lower-left origin of rows is not (0, 0);

ignore_net_degree.description: ignore net degree larger than some value

gp_noise_ratio.description: noise to initial positions for global placement

stop_overflow.description: stopping criteria, consider stop when the overflow reaches to a ratio

detailed_place_engine.description: external detailed placement engine to be called after placement

detailed_place_command.description: commands for external detailed placement engine

RePlAce_ref_hpwl.description: reference HPWL used in RePlAce for updating density weight

RePlAce_LOWER_PCOF.description: lower bound ratio used in RePlAce for updating density weight

RePlAce_UPPER_PCOF.description: upper bound ratio used in RePlAce for updating density weight

gamma.description: base coefficient for log-sum-exp and weighted-average wirelength, a relative value to bin size

RePlAce_skip_energy_flag.description: whether skip density energy computation for fast mode, may not work with some solvers

random_center_init_flag.description: whether perform random initialization around the center for global placement

gift_init_flag.description: whether perform GiFt initialization for global placement

sort_nets_by_degree.description: whether sort nets by degree or not

dump_global_place_solution_flag.description: whether dump intermediate global placement solution as a compressed pickle object

dump_legalize_solution_flag.description: whether dump intermediate legalization solution as a compressed pickle object

node_area_adjust_overflow.description: the overflow where to adjust node area

max_num_area_adjust.description: maximum times to adjust node area

ruplace_enforce_area_adjust_budget.description: enforce max_num_area_adjust on successful RUPlace plugin area-adjustment rounds

adjust_nctugr_area_flag.description: whether use NCTUgr congestion map to guide area adjustment

adjust_rudy_area_flag.description: whether use RUDY/RISA map to guide area adjustment

adjust_pin_area_flag.description: whether use pin utilization map to guide area adjustment

unit_horizontal_capacity.description: number of horizontal routing tracks per unit distance

unit_vertical_capacity.description: number of vertical routing tracks per unit distance

unit_pin_capacity.description: number of pins per unit area

route_opt_adjust_exponent.description: exponent to adjust the routing utilization map

deterministic_flag.description: whether require run-to-run determinism, may have efficiency overhead

ruplace_xplace_root.description: path to Xplace repository used as external GPU-router adapter

ruplace_gpugr_root.description: path to bundled/built GPUGR root; empty auto-detects the installed DREAMPlace bundle

ruplace_router_backend.description: GPU router backend for standalone GPUGR/RUPlace; supported values are gpugr, xplace, and instantgr

ruplace_instantgr_root.description: path to optional InstantGR third-party repository

ruplace_instantgr_binary.description: path to optional InstantGR executable; empty uses ruplace_instantgr_root/run/InstantGR

ruplace_instantgr_cap_input.description: native InstantGR .cap input for standalone instantgr backend; LEF/DEF export is not implemented in v1

ruplace_instantgr_net_input.description: native InstantGR .net input for standalone instantgr backend; LEF/DEF export is not implemented in v1

ruplace_gr_rrr_iters.description: GGR rip-up and reroute iterations for RUPlace route evaluations

ruplace_gr_util_mode.description: Congestion definition for the in-loop GR maps: legacy (dmd/cap, skip M1) or avail ((dmd-fixed)/(cap-fixed), the Innovus remain/total analogue)

ruplace_gr_grid.description: GR gcell grid: bins (default, route_num_bins / DEF routing grids), def (let the router use the DEF GCELLGRID), or an explicit NxM such as 625x650

ruplace_write_guides.description: 1 (default) = ask the router to write a route guide file each evaluation; 0 = skip it (route_guide="")

ruplace_gr_wire_cost_sat.description: 1 = saturate the pattern-router int64->int wire-cost difference at INF instead of letting it overflow (recovers the long nets that otherwise report `failed`); 0 = legacy

ruplace_gr_via_usage_scale.description: GGR via-usage scale factor (grSetting.viaUsageScale); 1.5 = the ISPD18-calibrated value, 0 disables the extra via demand

ruplace_gr_m1_routable.description: 1 = let GGR route on M1 (grSetting.m1Routable); 0 = treat M1 as unroutable (the SMIC14 setting)

ruplace_gr_max_route_len_per_pin.description: GGR maxRouteLenPerPin, the per-pin route-length budget in gcells; 130 = ISPD18 calibration, 256 for the coarser s14 grid

ruplace_route_gpu.description: CUDA device id used by the Xplace GPU-router adapter

ruplace_external_route_eval.description: run Xplace GGR in a subprocess to avoid CUDA context corruption during placement

ruplace_inflate_start_overflow.description: density overflow threshold to start RUPlace inflation; negative uses node_area_adjust_overflow

ruplace_max_inflate_ratio.description: maximum cell inflation ratio used by RUPlace

ruplace_min_inflate_ratio.description: minimum cumulative cell inflation ratio used by RUPlace local adjustment

ruplace_global_inflate_gamma.description: damping factor for RUPlace global clustered inflation

ruplace_global_cluster_mode.description: global RUPlace inflation aggregation mode: mean, max, or none

ruplace_global_util_exponent.description: exponent applied to global route utilization excess before RUPlace inflation

ruplace_local_inflate_gamma.description: smoothing factor for RUPlace local cell area adjustment

ruplace_inflate_area_cap.description: maximum movable-area growth fraction per RUPlace inflation round

ruplace_inflate_util_threshold.description: route utilization fraction treated as congested by RUPlace inflation; node utilization is divided by this before clamping at 1.0, so 1.0 is legacy behaviour and smaller values inflate cells in less-congested bins

ruplace_inflate_extra_capacity.description: extra movable-area budget allowed for RUPlace inflation when filler whitespace is unavailable

ruplace_congested_uniform_inflate_ratio.description: fallback uniform inflation ratio when GGR reports congestion but center-bin utilization gives no positive inflation target

ruplace_node_util_window.description: neighboring routing-bin radius used to max-smooth RUPlace node utilization before inflation

ruplace_node_util_blend.description: blend between center-bin and max-smoothed utilization when ruplace_node_util_window is positive

ruplace_hv_inflate_gamma.description: extra inflation pressure from H/V route overflow maps; 0 disables directional H/V-aware inflation

ruplace_hv_inflate_mode.description: how to combine horizontal and vertical overflow for H/V-aware inflation: max, mean, sum, h, or v

ruplace_allow_shrink.description: allow RUPlace local adjustment to shrink over-inflated cells back toward the minimum inflation ratio

ruplace_local_congestion_stop.description: route overflow threshold to stop RUPlace local inflation

ruplace_local_ovfl_nets_stop.description: maximum overflow-net count treated as congestion-free for RUPlace local inflation

ruplace_local_est_shorts_stop.description: maximum estimated-short count treated as congestion-free for RUPlace local inflation

ruplace_admm_start_overflow.description: density overflow threshold to start RUPlace ADMM routed-wire refinement

ruplace_admm_route_freq.description: placement iterations between RUPlace ADMM route refreshes

ruplace_admm_apply_freq.description: placement iterations between applying RUPlace ADMM route gradients

ruplace_admm_weight.description: weight for RUPlace routed-wire ADMM gradient

ruplace_admm_scale_mode.description: routeforce scaling: absolute uses the raw ADMM coefficient; relative interprets the weight as a fraction of raw placement-gradient RMS

ruplace_admm_max_ratio.description: maximum routeforce-to-placement gradient RMS ratio in relative scaling mode

ruplace_admm_weight_decay.description: multiplicative decay applied to RUPlace ADMM gradient weight after each application

ruplace_admm_min_weight.description: minimum RUPlace ADMM gradient weight after decay; 0 disables the floor

ruplace_admm_grad_clip_norm.description: global norm used to clip RUPlace ADMM route gradients before weighting; 0 disables clipping

ruplace_admm_anchor_weight.description: anchor penalty weight for RUPlace ADMM route gradient

ruplace_admm_anchor_update.description: anchor update policy for RUPlace ADMM route gradient: refresh, static, or ema

ruplace_admm_anchor_decay.description: EMA decay for RUPlace ADMM anchor update when ruplace_admm_anchor_update is ema

ruplace_plugins.description: independent routability operations, as a list or comma-separated string; empty preserves the legacy RUPlace controller

ruplace_proxy.description: congestion proxy for plugins: gpugr, xplace, rudy, pin_density, nctugr, or rudy_pin

ruplace_proxy_refresh_interval.description: placement iterations between congestion proxy refreshes

ruplace_proxy_route_weight.description: RUDY weight in the rudy_pin composite proxy

ruplace_proxy_pin_weight.description: pin-density weight in the rudy_pin composite proxy

ruplace_plugin_start_overflow.description: density overflow threshold at which gradient-based routability plugins become active

ruplace_force_scale_mode.description: force scaling for gradient plugins including local_gradient, directional_path_spreading, net_overlap, poisson_force, and whitespace: absolute preserves legacy coefficients; relative interprets each plugin weight as a fraction of raw placement-gradient RMS

ruplace_force_max_ratio.description: maximum per-plugin raw placement-gradient RMS ratio in relative force-scaling mode

ruplace_force_congestion_mode.description: force congestion map: aggregate overflow; utilization; overflow-directional hv_max, hv_mean, horizontal, or vertical; or absolute-directional utilization_hv_max, utilization_hv_mean, utilization_horizontal, or utilization_vertical

ruplace_force_smoothing_padding.description: force-map smoothing boundary mode: zero preserves legacy behavior; replicate avoids artificial constant-map boundary gradients

ruplace_force_physical_bins.description: use physical routing-bin dimensions for net-overlap and whitespace map gradients; false preserves legacy index-space behavior

ruplace_force_apply_interval.description: placement iterations between local-gradient, net-overlap, Poisson, and whitespace force applications

ruplace_force_apply_offset.description: application phase offset in [0, apply_interval) for gradient-based routability forces

ruplace_force_max_applications.description: maximum successful applications per gradient-based routability force; -1 is unlimited

ruplace_force_decay.description: multiplicative force-weight decay per successful application; plugin-specific ruplace_<plugin>_decay parameters override it

ruplace_force_min_ratio.description: minimum annealed force-weight ratio relative to the configured plugin weight

ruplace_force_stagnation_window.description: distinct proxy observations required before a local-gradient force activates; 1 disables trend gating

ruplace_force_stagnation_tolerance.description: maximum fractional proxy-overflow improvement still classified as stagnant across the force gate window

ruplace_force_min_overflow_sum.description: minimum selected-map overflow sum required by an enabled local-gradient stagnation gate

ruplace_force_min_overflow_bins.description: minimum positive selected-map overflow-bin count required by an enabled local-gradient stagnation gate

ruplace_force_gate_utilization_threshold.description: utilization threshold subtracted before severity and stagnation gating of utilization-map feedback

ruplace_momentum_step.description: step size for momentum cell-inflation updates

ruplace_local_gradient_smooth.description: smoothing radius for the local congestion-gradient map

ruplace_aggregate_cvar_gradient_weight.description: node-level aggregate utilization-tail CVaR congestion-gradient weight

ruplace_aggregate_cvar_gradient_smooth.description: smoothing radius for the aggregate CVaR pressure map

ruplace_aggregate_cvar_gradient_quantile.description: aggregate utilization quantile defining the CVaR tail

ruplace_aggregate_cvar_gradient_tail_ble.description: blend from aggregate overflow pressure at zero to aggregate utilization-tail excess at one

ruplace_aggregate_pnorm_gradient_smooth.description: smoothing radius for the aggregate Lp overflow-pressure map

ruplace_aggregate_pnorm_gradient_exponen.description: Lp exponent applied to aggregate utilization above capacity

ruplace_aggregate_pnorm_gradient_thresho.description: aggregate utilization threshold for the Lp pressure objective

ruplace_directional_local_gradient_smoot.description: smoothing radius for separate H/V local-gradient maps

ruplace_directional_local_gradient_feedb.description: directional local-gradient feedback maps: overflow or utilization

ruplace_directional_local_gradient_mode.description: cross-track response for both directions, horizontal routes only, or vertical routes only: both, horizontal, or vertical

route-direction to displacement-axis mapping: cross_track or matching_axis

ruplace_directional_local_gradient_polar.description: directional pressure response: repel or attract

ruplace_directional_local_gradient_norma.description: directional field normalization: joint or per_axis

ruplace_directional_local_gradient_aggre.description: fraction of aggregate congestion-map gradient blended into the directional H/V field

directional local-gradient tail guard metric: max, p99, or max_p99
maximum fractional increase over the best observed guarded H/V utilization tail

ruplace_directional_cvar_gradient_smooth.description: smoothing radius for separate H/V CVaR pressure maps

ruplace_directional_cvar_gradient_quanti.description: per-direction utilization quantile defining the CVaR tail

ruplace_directional_cvar_gradient_tail_b.description: blend from routed overflow pressure at zero to utilization-tail excess at one

ruplace_directional_cvar_gradient_mode.description: CVaR response for both directions, horizontal routes only, or vertical routes only: both, horizontal, or vertical

ruplace_directional_cvar_gradient_axis_b.description: positive X/Y balance for directional CVaR response; values above 1 emphasize X displacement

ruplace_directional_cvar_gradient_axis_m.description: CVaR route-direction to displacement-axis mapping: cross_track or matching_axis

ruplace_directional_cvar_gradient_polari.description: directional CVaR pressure response: repel or attract

ruplace_directional_cvar_gradient_normal.description: directional CVaR field normalization: joint or per_axis

ruplace_directional_excess_cvar_gradient.description: node-level capacity-conditioned directional CVaR congestion-gradient weight
smoothing radius for capacity-conditioned H/V CVaR pressure maps
per-direction quantile among utilization-above-one bins defining the conditioned CVaR tail
blend from routed overflow pressure at zero to capacity-conditioned utilization-tail excess at one
capacity-conditioned CVaR response for both directions, horizontal routes only, or vertical routes only: both, horizontal, or vertical
positive X/Y balance for capacity-conditioned directional CVaR response; values above 1 emphasize X displacement
capacity-conditioned CVaR route-direction to displacement-axis mapping: cross_track or matching_axis
capacity-conditioned directional CVaR pressure response: repel or attract
capacity-conditioned directional CVaR field normalization: joint or per_axis

ruplace_poisson_smooth.description: smoothing radius for the Poisson congestion charge map

ruplace_poisson_solver.description: Poisson congestion-field boundary solver: periodic preserves the historical FFT implementation; neumann_dct uses DREAMPlace's zero-flux DCT field

ruplace_poisson_directional_mode.description: Poisson congestion-field response: scalar solves one selected congestion map; cross_track separately solves H/V utilization and applies V pressure on X and H pressure on Y

ruplace_poisson_axis_balance.description: positive X/Y balance for scalar or cross-track Poisson response; values above 1 emphasize X displacement and values below 1 emphasize Y displacement

ruplace_net_weight_freq.description: placement iterations between congestion-aware net-weight updates

ruplace_net_weight_decay.description: multiplicative gamma decay after each effective congestion-aware net-weight update

ruplace_net_weight_min_ratio.description: minimum annealed gamma ratio relative to ruplace_net_weight_gamma

ruplace_net_weight_max.description: maximum multiplier for congestion-aware net weights

ruplace_net_weight_normalization.description: net congestion score normalization: absolute or design_mean

ruplace_net_weight_phase.description: net-weight update phase: post_gradient queues weights for the next objective after current-gradient preconditioning; pre_objective updates weights before wirelength objective construction

ruplace_net_weight_bbox_power.description: positive exponent for peak-sensitive bbox_pmean net congestion scoring

ruplace_net_relaxation_min_weight.description: minimum objective-weight multiplier for a congested active net

ruplace_net_relaxation_normalization.description: net-relaxation congestion score normalization: absolute or design_mean

ruplace_net_relaxation_phase.description: net-relaxation update phase: post_gradient or pre_objective

ruplace_net_relaxation_direction_mode.description: net-relaxation congestion map: aggregate, max_hv, mean_hv, horizontal, or vertical

ruplace_directional_net_contraction_appl.description: placement iterations between directional net-contraction applications

ruplace_directional_net_contraction_scor.description: directional net congestion aggregation: pin_mean, bbox_mean, or bbox_pmean

ruplace_directional_net_contraction_norm.description: directional net-contraction congestion normalization: absolute, shared design_mean, or independent axis_mean

ruplace_directional_path_spreading_apply.description: placement iterations between directional route-path spreading applications

ruplace_connection_routeforce_decay.description: multiplicative connection routeforce weight decay per application

ruplace_connection_routeforce_min_ratio.description: minimum connection routeforce weight ratio after annealing

ruplace_connection_routeforce_distance_w.description: distance weighting along routed segments: uniform or inverse_sqrt
